name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company building a diversified portfolio of precious metal royalties on producing, pre-production, and pre-resource properties in Nevada. The company's business model targets low overhead by acquiring net smelter royalties and exploration stream earn-in agreements rather than operating mines directly. Its primary asset is a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and Exploration Stream Earn-in at the Lapon Canyon Project in Nevada.
